extDescription.message: Keeps tab groups first, one group expanded, and new tabs in the group you are using.

defaultGroupTitle.description: Default title of the group that collects ungrouped tabs (≤ 30 chars).

errorDefaultTitleTaken.message: A group named “$TITLE$” is already open. Choose another default group name.
errorDefaultTitleTaken.description: Shown when the new default group title clashes with an open group.

popupGroupCount.description: Popup: number of groups in this window.

popupActiveGroup.description: Popup: group of the active tab.

popupNormalize.description: Popup: button that re-applies the rules.

groupNone.description: The active tab is not in a group.

statusEnabled.description: Status after turning the extension on.

statusDisabled.description: Status after turning the extension off.

statusTidied.description: Status after tidying the current window.

optionsEyebrow.description: Small caption above the options heading.

optionsLede.message: Organizes tabs per window: groups first, one expanded group, new tabs in the expanded group.

layoutHint.message: Applied automatically to every normal window.

groupsFirstDesc.message: Ungrouped tabs go after all groups.

singleExpandedDesc.message: The active tab's group stays expanded; the others collapse.

keepLastTitle.message: Keep a group expanded on pinned tabs

keepLastDesc.message: When off, activating a pinned tab collapses every group.

headerHint.message: How focus moves when you click a group header.

expandHeaderTitle.message: Switch tabs when expanding a group

expandHeaderDesc.message: Clicking a collapsed group's header activates its most recently used tab.

expandedHeaderDesc.message: Only with “Expand only one group” on. Pinned tabs don't affect it.

headerActionNewtab.message: Open a new tab in the group

headerActionCollapse.message: Collapse it and expand the default group

headerCollapseNote.message: With “Collapse it and expand the default group”, clicking the default group itself changes nothing; without a default group the current group stays expanded.

newTabsHint.message: Decides which group newly opened tabs join.

defaultGroupToggleDesc.message: Ungrouped tabs join the default group automatically.

externalTitle.message: External tabs join the current group

externalDesc.message: Tabs opened by a terminal or another app go to the expanded group; when off, to the default group.

newTabsNote.message: Ctrl+T and address-bar new tabs always join the expanded group; links keep Chrome's default behavior.

defaultGroupNote.message: Changing the name or color renames the existing default group too.

shortcutHint.message: Jump back to the default group at any time.

shortcutChange.description: Button that opens Chrome's shortcut page.

shortcutNote.message: Chrome doesn't let extensions change shortcuts directly; “Change” opens Chrome's extension shortcuts page. Suggested default:
shortcutNote.description: Card note, followed by the key combination.

shortcutOpenManually.description: Error when the shortcut page cannot be opened.

pinnedHint.message: Matched by title and color; groups with the same title and color are pinned together. List order is tab strip order.

pinnedOpenGroupsLabel.description: Accessible label of the group picker.

pinButton.description: Button that pins the selected group.

pinnedNoteProtection.message: Chrome has no API to prevent deleting a group, so pinning keeps it from becoming empty: after its last tab closes, the extension recreates a group with the same title and color holding one inactive blank tab. Your real tabs are never reopened.

pinnedNoteOrder.message: Pinned order always applies. Because sorting puts every group before ungrouped tabs, pinning also implies “groups first”.

pinnedNotOpen.description: A pinned group that is not open in any window.

pinnedSharedCount.message: $COUNT$ groups with this title and color are pinned together
pinnedSharedCount.description: Several open groups match one pinned entry.

pinNoCandidates.description: Picker placeholder when nothing can be pinned.

pinOptionLabelCount.description: Picker entry for several matching groups.

tidyHint.message: Re-apply group order, the default group and single-expanded rules.
